name: estimate_ride
description: Calculates price, availability, ETA, and payment options for a NEO Taxi ride. Always call this before create_booking to get a valid quote_id. The quote expires in 15 minutes.

pickup.description: Pickup location. Provide address always. Coordinates are optional but improve accuracy.

address.description: Full street address of the pickup location, e.g. 'Leopoldstraße 25, Munich, Germany'

destination.description: Destination location. Provide address always. Coordinates are optional but improve accuracy.

address.description: Full street address of the destination, e.g. 'Munich Airport, Terminal 2'

pickup_time.description: ISO 8601 datetime for the desired pickup, e.g. '2026-04-25T06:30:00+02:00'. Must be in the future.

vehicle_type.description: Type of vehicle: standard (up to 4 pax), business (premium, 4 pax), van (up to 8 pax)

name: create_booking
description: Creates a confirmed NEO Taxi booking after the customer has approved the price estimate. Requires a valid quote_id from estimate_ride. Always confirm the price and pickup time with the customer before calling this.

quote_id.description: The quote UUID returned by estimate_ride. Must not be expired.

name.description: Full name of the customer, e.g. 'Max Müller'

phone.description: Customer phone number in E.164 format, e.g. '+491701234567'

payment_mode.description: How the customer will pay for the ride

notes.description: Optional instructions for the driver, e.g. 'Please wait at the main entrance'

name: get_booking_status
description: Returns the current status of a NEO Taxi booking including driver details, vehicle info, and real-time ETA. Use this when the customer asks where their driver is or what the status of their ride is.

booking_id.description: The booking code returned by create_booking, e.g. 'BK-ABCD1234EF'

name: cancel_booking
description: Cancels a NEO Taxi booking. Cancellation is only possible before a driver has been assigned. If a driver is already assigned, inform the customer to contact support instead.

booking_id.description: The booking code to cancel, e.g. 'BK-ABCD1234EF'
